Job Description  

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Learning \& Development Manager to join our organization in Pune, India. In this pivotal role, you will lead the strategic design, development, and implementation of comprehensive training and development programs that drive organizational excellence and foster a culture of continuous learning. As an L\&D Manager, you will partner with senior leadership and department heads to align learning initiatives with business objectives, while championing employee growth and engagement across the organization.

* Develop, implement, and oversee the annual training plan and budget, ensuring strategic alignment with organizational goals and efficient resource allocation
* Conduct comprehensive Training Needs Analysis (TNA) in collaboration with department heads and senior management to identify skill gaps and training requirements
* Design, customize, and deliver engaging training programs—both internal and external—across all organizational levels and departments
* Lead and mentor the L\&D team, fostering a collaborative and innovative environment that encourages creative problem\-solving and professional development
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure training effectiveness, ROI, and impact on organizational performance
* Manage Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training technology platforms to streamline enrollment, delivery, and tracking of programs
* Coordinate with external training vendors and consultants to supplement internal capabilities and ensure access to specialized expertise
* Actively drive employee engagement initiatives and development programs that support talent retention and career progression
* Analyze training data and provide actionable insights and recommendations for continuous improvement and program optimization
* Stay current with industry best practices, emerging learning technologies, and adult learning principles to keep programs innovative and relevant
* Foster an inclusive and supportive learning culture that empowers employees to develop new skills and advance their career paths

  

Qualifications  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Organizational Development, Business Administration, or a related field
* Minimum 5–7 years of progressive experience in Learning \& Development, training program management, or organizational development, preferably in a corporate or service\-oriented environment
* Proven expertise in training program design, development, and delivery across diverse audiences
* Strong proficiency with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and training technology platforms
* Demonstrated experience in conducting Training Needs Analysis and translating findings into actionable learning strategies
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, and presentation skills with the ability to engage and motivate diverse groups
* Strong analytical and data interpretation skills to measure training effectiveness and calculate ROI
* Proficiency in budget management, financial planning, and resource allocation
* Experience in team leadership, staff management, and building high\-performing L\&D teams
* Knowledge of adult learning principles, instructional design, and curriculum development
* Familiarity with change management and organizational development initiatives
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across all organizational levels and build strong stakeholder relationships
* Preferred: Certification in training and development (such as ASTD, CIPD, or equivalent), experience with vendor management, or background in specific industry training requirements

title: Head of HR Centers of Excellence (CoE)
description:
Papaya Global is a rapidly growing, award\-winning B2B tech unicorn on a mission to revolutionize the payroll and payments industry.


As Papaya continues to scale globally, we are looking for a Head of HR Centers of Excellence (CoE) to lead our global HR domains and build the capabilities, practices, and experiences that support our growth as a global, high\-growth unicorn with strong market presence.


This is a senior leadership role focused on elevating the depth and impact of each HR domain, and translating business strategy into effective, high\-quality People practices. You will lead a global team of domain experts and shape a cohesive People strategy across all CoE functions, ensuring a consistent and meaningful employee experience across the organization.


This role requires a combination of strategic thinking and a hands\-on, dynamic approach, with the ability to operate flexibly and creatively in a fast\-changing environment.

**Why Join Us:**

* Opportunity to build and scale the People infrastructure of a fast\-growing, global organization at a pivotal stage of scale.
* High\-impact leadership role with strong visibility.
* Dynamic environment with room to shape and innovate.
* Perfect for ones who perceived themselves as\- Leaders, Builders, Accelerators!

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and develop global functional leads across Total Rewards, Learning \& Development, People Operations, HRIS, Talent Management and People Analytics.
* Elevate the depth, quality, and impact of each HR domain, ensuring best\-in\-class, forward\-thinking People practices.
* Shape how People strategy is translated into day\-to\-day reality, ensuring practices are practical, relevant, and drive real business impact.
* Drive a cohesive and high\-quality employee experience by connecting all HR domains into a consistent and meaningful lifecycle.
* Partner closely with HRBPs and leadership to understand business needs and translate them into impactful People solutions.
* Act as a thought partner on organizational design, workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness.
* Build and evolve organizational capabilities, strengthening leadership, management effectiveness, and overall performance.
* Foster innovation across People practices by continuously challenging existing approaches and introducing new ideas, tools, and ways of working, including the use of AI.
* Ensure strong operational foundations, systems, and data that enable scale, efficiency, and informed decision\-making.
* Support the organization’s growth by building People practices that are ready for scale, global expansion, and increasing complexity.

  

Requirements:
  

* 10–15\+ years of HR experience, including leadership of multiple HR domains or Centers of Excellence.
* Proven experience managing senior HR leaders across different disciplines.
* Strong experience building and evolving People practices in high\-growth or global organizations.
* Deep expertise in at least two HR domains, with strong cross\-functional understanding.
* Experience working closely with senior leadership and influencing at executive levels.
* Strong systems thinking and Data\-driven mindset with experience in HR systems and analytics.
* A highly proactive, hands\-on approach with the ability to dive into details.
* Strong creativity and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to think beyond standard HR practices.
* Flexibility and adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Exceptional clarity of thought, intellectual rigor, strong judgment, and outstanding communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and influence diverse stakeholders.
* Advantage: Exposure to M\&A and post\-merger integration.

**Location:** Bangalore

**Experience:** 3–7 years

**Role Overview:**

We're a company with three decades of existence and still growing, now moving at startup speed. The person who keeps our recruiter pods performing at that speed, consistently, is the Team Lead.

This is not a senior recruiter role with a different title. Your primary output is the performance of other people, not your own numbers. You run a recruiter pod where every Talent Growth Specialist reaches their individual potential and the pod collectively exceeds what any one of them could produce alone. You are building capability, not just output.

If you have fully made the shift from focusing on what you personally deliver to what your team produces, this role is built for you.

**What You'll Do:**

* Run a recruiter pod end to end including mandate assignment, SLA coverage, capacity planning, and delivery consistency
* Coach Talent Growth Specialists through feedback that teaches, not just corrects
* Use every profile rejection as a coaching opportunity to improve future performance
* Monitor pod performance daily and maintain visibility on mandates, SLAs, and capacity without being asked
* Act as the filter between pod operations and senior stakeholders so escalation does not become noise
* Ensure Account Managers and Client Partners are not pulled into delivery firefighting
* Escalate with precision by solving what is within your control and raising what is not
* Identify retention risks within your pod early and act before they turn into exits
* Understand each recruiter’s career trajectory and actively support their growth

**Who You Are:**

* 3 to 7 years of experience in recruitment with exposure to leading or mentoring teams
* You have transitioned from individual contributor to people leader and are committed to that path
* You develop people through structured feedback rather than instruction alone
* Strong operational discipline with clear visibility on SLA timelines, capacity, and mandate coverage
* You create a stable performance environment where clarity and confidence drive results
* Comfortable having direct, honest, and constructive conversations when required

**Why NetConnect:**

28,000 plus professionals have worked with us across India over three decades. The platform handles reporting, SLA monitoring, and daily metrics so you are not spending your time on manual tracking. You focus on people, decisions, and performance.

NetConnect is scaling. Team Leads who join now will go on to lead larger pods and eventually other Team Leads as the business grows. The Head of Delivery roles opening over the next two years will be built from this layer.

The Talent Growth Specialists who move through your pod should leave stronger than they arrived. Some will become Team Leads, some will become Account Managers. Their trajectory is part of your legacy here.

description:
**Delivery Manager — US Public Sector IT Talent Acquisition** **Location:** Ahmedabad, Gujarat**Shift timings:** 6:30 PM – 3:30 AM IST **ABOUT DASH TECHNOLOGIES**
Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio and founded in 2010, Dash Technologies Inc. is an ISO 9001\-certified, fast\-growing IT services and staffing organization serving enterprise and US government clients. Recognized by Inc. Magazine among Columbus's fastest\-growing private companies, Dash partners with 25\+ US state government agencies and federal stakeholders on mission\-critical technology programs — from AI strategy implementation and cloud modernization to large\-scale digital transformation.
Our US Public Sector practice is in a high\-growth phase. We are scaling our India\-based delivery engine to match — and we are looking for a senior recruitment leader who can build, modernize, and run it. **About the Role:**
This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role for a recruitment professional who has spent years inside US IT staffing — specifically delivering against state, local, and federal government requisitions — and now wants to modernize a fast\-growing public sector practice with AI, automation, and a sharper pipeline strategy. You will own US public sector recruitment delivery from India, working in the US time zone, partnering directly with the CEO on weekly cadence, and shaping how Dash hires for its 25\+ state agency clients.
You will not just run requisitions. You will redesign how they get run — choosing the ATS and AI tools that fit, building reusable benches, automating low\-value steps, and raising the quality bar on every candidate that goes to a client. You bring strong technology fundamentals (a real engineering or computer science degree, ideally from a recognized institute), genuine curiosity about where the staffing industry is heading, and the self\-starter energy to turn a directive into a working system. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN****Public Sector Delivery (State, Local, Federal)*** Run end\-to\-end contingent and contract\-to\-hire delivery across state agencies, county and city IT offices, and federal engagements.
* Manage requisition intake, sourcing, submissions, interview coordination, offer, and onboarding through MSP/VMS platforms — Beeline, SAP Fieldglass, VectorVMS, PeopleFluent, Dotstaff, and state\-specific portals (e.g., Workday Strategic Sourcing, NYS HBITS, CMS\-style state vehicles).
* Own SLAs that matter: time\-to\-submit, submission\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-fill, fill rate, and 90\-day attrition. Drive 95%\+ fill rate on priority requisitions.
* Lead account\-level QBRs with US client partners and translate scorecards into operational changes on the India delivery floor.

**AI, Automation \& Productivity*** Select, configure, and operate the modern recruitment tech stack: AI\-first ATS platforms (CEIPAL, Bullhorn, sourcing intelligence (LinkedIn Recruiter), and outreach automation.
* Deploy AI for resume parsing, candidate\-job match scoring, JD generation, screening note summarization, and interview transcription — with human\-in\-the\-loop controls and clear audit trails.
* Build dashboards and reusable templates that cut recruiter admin time meaningfully (target: 30–40% reduction) so the team focuses on conversations, not data entry.
* Stay current on AI\-in\-hiring regulation at the US state level

**Quality, Pipeline \& Bench Strategy*** Run a structured QA/QC layer on every submission: technical fit, communication, location/clearance match, rate alignment, document compliance — before it touches a client portal.
* Lead candidate interview prep: behavioral coaching, client\-specific briefings, mock technicals, and follow\-up debriefs — so submitted candidates arrive ready, not hopeful.
* Build warm benches and named\-talent pools for repeat skill profiles (Mainframe, Salesforce public sector, ServiceNow, AWS/Azure cloud architects, data engineering, QA automation, cybersecurity, AI/ML).
* Identify and incubate bench projects — investing in a small, pre\-vetted cohort that can be deployed quickly when state requisitions drop.

**Compliance, Visa \& Documentation*** Own end\-to\-end compliance for public sector hiring: E\-Verify, I\-9, state\-specific clearances and background checks.
* Manage the visa landscape with confidence

**CEO Partnership \& Strategy*** Work in a direct weekly cadence with the CEO — translating growth strategy into staffing OKRs, surfacing market signals from the recruiter floor, and helping shape pricing, capacity, and client portfolio decisions.
* Represent the India delivery engine in US client conversations when needed; comfortable presenting numbers, owning misses, and proposing fixes.
* Contribute to RFP responses, capability statements, and case studies for new state pursuits.

**Team Leadership*** Build and mentor a high\-performance recruiter pod— set standards for productivity, ethics, and client communication; invest in their careers.

 **TOOLS \& TECH STACK YOU'LL OPERATE****ATS / CRM:** CEIPAL **·** Bullhorn **·** JobDiva**MSP / VMS:** Beeline **·** SAP Fieldglass **·** VectorVMSDotstaff**Sourcing \& Intelligence:** LinkedIn Recruiter **·** Apollo.io **·** ZoomInfo **·** Indeed Resume **·** Dice**AI \& Automation:**Claude **·** ChatGPT / GPT\-5 **·** Gemini **·** Copilot **·** Eightfold (FedRAMP\-Moderate) **·** Paradox **·** Textio **·** HireVue**Productivity \& Analytics:** Excel (advanced) **·** Power BI / Looker **·** Microsoft 365 **·** Slack **·** Zapier / Make **·** Google Workspace **WHAT YOU BRING****Must Have*** **Education:** Bachelor's in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related technology discipline from a strong institution (NITs, IITs, BITS, top state universities, or recognized engineering colleges). A real technology degree, not adjacent — you should be able to read a JD for a senior cloud architect and understand what the words mean.
* **Experience:** 8\+ years in US IT staffing delivery, with at least 5 years dedicated to US public sector — state, local, county/city, and/or federal civilian. You've worked on multiple state vehicles end\-to\-end.
* **Public Sector Depth:** Direct working experience with state agencies (e.g., DOT, HHS, Revenue, Workforce, Judicial), county/city IT offices, or federal civilian programs (HHS, DoD\-adjacent civilian, GSA schedules).
* **Tooling:** Hands\-on with at least 2 modern ATS platforms and at least 2 VMS/MSP environments. You've shipped change in these systems — not just used them.
* **AI Fluency:** You actively use AI tools in your daily work — for sourcing, screening, writing, summarization. You can articulate what AI does well, where it fails, and how to keep humans in the loop.
* **Communication:** Fluent, professional American English — written and verbal — with the presence to engage US clients and the CEO directly.
* **Ownership:** Self\-starter. Comfortable starting from a one\-line directive from the CEO and returning with a working plan, the right tools, and a deadline.

**Strong Plus / Differentiators*** Built or rolled out an automation playbook (Zapier, Make, custom GPT workflows) inside an ATS.
* Track record of training/mentoring recruiters into senior roles.
* Genuine curiosity about emerging tech trends — agentic AI, talent intelligence platforms, skills\-based hiring, gov\-tech modernization. You read, you experiment, you bring ideas back.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **System Design and Optimization**: Design, develop, and optimize instrumentation systems for controlling and monitoring polymer and textile manufacturing processes instrument.
* **Installation and Commissioning**: Oversee the installation, calibration, and commissioning of instrumentation systems such as flow meters, temperature sensors, pressure transmitters, and level controllers in the plant's machinery and equipment.
* **Maintenance and Troubleshooting**: Conduct regular maintenance and troubleshooting of instrumentation equipment to minimize downtime, ensure high\-quality production, and resolve issues such as inaccurate readings or malfunctioning sensors.
* **Control Systems Management**: Manage control systems (such as PLCs, SCADA, and DCS) for real\-time monitoring of critical parameters, and optimize production processes based on the data collected from instruments.
* **Calibration and Validation**: Calibrate and validate the measurement and control instruments used in polymer and textile manufacturing to ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* **Process Data Analysis**: Monitor and analyse process data from the instruments, identifying performance trends and making recommendations for process improvements, energy savings, and product quality optimization.
* **Safety and Compliance**: Ensure that all instrumentation systems meet safety standards, environmental regulations, and industry best practices, particularly in areas related to chemical handling, heat management, and wastewater treatment.
* **Collaboration**: Work closely with process engineers, plant operators, and maintenance teams to ensure proper integration of instrumentation systems into the production lines.
* **Documentation and Reporting**: Maintain detailed documentation of equipment installation, calibration procedures, troubleshooting actions, and process data. Report on system performance and any corrective actions taken.
* **Project Management**: Assist with or lead instrumentation\-related projects, including the upgrade of control systems, the introduction of new equipment, and the automation of processes.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* **Technical Skills**:
* Strong understanding of instrumentation systems used in manufacturing, such as temperature sensors, flow meters, pressure transmitters, and actuators.
* Experience with control systems (PLC, DCS, SCADA) and automation of polymer or textile processes.

The Junior Academic Counsellor plays a key role in guiding prospective students toward the right deep\-tech career pathways at Technovalley. * Comprehensive training on all technology stacks and compliance standards

**Job Title: Creative \& Social Media Manager (Design \+ Motion \+ Strategy)**

**Company: TradeClover**

**Location:** Office No. 1505, 15th Floor, The Orion Business Park, Shimpoli Junction, S.V. Road, Borivali West, Mumbai 400092 **Job Type:** Full\-Time \| In\-Person Only

**Compensation:** ₹25,000 per month

**Experience Required:** Minimum 3 years

**Read This Before Applying**

This is not a "post daily and reply to comments" role. You will be the only creative person on the team. No creative director above you. No team below you. No one to design for you, edit your videos, or tell you what to post. You will own TradeClover's entire visual identity and social media presence from top to bottom. If you need direction on what to create, this is not for you. If you can build a brand presence from scratch and make it grow, keep reading.

**What You Must Know (Non\-Negotiable)**

* **Design:** Figma — UI mockups, social creatives, pitch decks, brand assets. Not just templates, actual design sense.
* **Motion \& Animation:** 2D animations using After Effects, Jitter, or equivalent. Motion graphics for reels, explainer videos, product walkthroughs. Not just transitions.
* **Video Production:** Scripting, shooting (basic), and editing full\-length videos — not just 30\-second reels. YouTube\-style content, demo videos, testimonials.
* **Short\-Form Content:** Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts — but this is the floor, not the ceiling.
* **Strategy:** Content calendars, platform\-specific strategies, growth planning, knowing what content to make and why.
* **Copywriting:** Writing captions, hooks, video scripts, and ad copy that actually convert. You understand tone.
* **Analytics:** Reading what works and what doesn't across Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube. You make decisions from data, not feelings.
* **Platform Fluency:** Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube — you understand how each algorithm works and you tailor content accordingly.
* **Brand Building:** You can take a B2B startup with zero presence and build something people recognize and trust.

**What You Will Own**

Everything creative. Brand identity, social presence across all platforms, video content, motion graphics, creatives for campaigns, ad visuals, onboarding decks, and anything else the company needs visually. You decide the strategy. You execute it. You measure it. You improve it.

**Who Should NOT Apply**

* Anyone who only knows how to make reels and post them
* Anyone who needs a designer to hand them assets to edit
* Anyone who has never made a video longer than 60 seconds
* Anyone who cannot think in strategy and only works execution
* Anyone looking for remote or hybrid work
* Anyone whose Figma skills go only as far as Canva\-style templates
* Freshers or anyone with under 3 years of real, end\-to\-end creative experience

**How To Apply**

Apply only if you meet every requirement listed above. Send your portfolio and resume to **tradeclover01@gmail.com** with the subject line: **Creative \& Social Media Manager — TradeClover**

 Deployment of public cloud network services including virtual networks, load balancers, web application firewalls, and virtual gateways.
   

  

 Execution of standard network delivery processes such as VLAN creation, route advertisements, firewall policy configurations, DNS record changes, IPAM network creation, network performance reports, network infrastructure hardening, software/hardware licensing, and virtual network peering.

 Collaboration with architecture teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.

 Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
   

  

 Knowledge of scripting, automation, and DevOps functions including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC).
   

  

 Experience working with Fortinet, Cisco, InfoBlox, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.

 Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Experience with ITSM, ITIL, NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001 frameworks.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
   

  

 Experience with working with onshore and offshore global teams.
   

  

 Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.

 Job Title
   

  

 Network Engineer
   

  

 Job Description:
   

  

 Our technology is outstanding, but it’s the talented, diverse, and driven people behind our company who make it all happen. Our employees have the determination to go further, the adaptability to adjust to an ever\-changing global market, the heart to stay passionate and personally invested, and the mind to know when to step back and put it all in perspective.
   

  

 Lexmark (A Subsidiary of Xerox Corporation) is in search of a seasoned network operations engineer with a passion for operating, executing, and enhancing standard processes for maintaining an enterprise network. The selected candidate will collaborate with multiple teams to ensure the implementation of IT operations, security, and network policies. The role involves working with architecture and business teams to ensure the availability of the enterprise network. The engineer will also be responsible for monitoring tool efficiency, setting guidelines, and eliminating barriers to achieve desired outcomes.  Remote Administration and troubleshooting of switches, routers, firewalls, and cloud networks.

 Deployment of public cloud network services including virtual networks, load balancers, web application firewalls, and virtual gateways.

 Collaboration with architecture teams providing design feedback, process improvement opportunities, and potential solution enhancements.
   

  

 Act as the escalation contact for the network helpdesk and incident managers.
   

  

 Communicate regularly with management and architecture teams on operational metrics.
   

  

 Light travel will be required to meet with international teams.
   

  

 Hands on support for the deployment of new infrastructure and maintenance of existing infrastructure at the company headquarters location.
   

  

 Be an advocate and change leader for network\-security initiatives and operational processes with a goal of improving the overall culture.

 Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering or related field with 3\-5 years of networking and security experience.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of LAN, WAN, VLAN, Public Cloud, Wireless, and VoIP networking technologies.
   

  

 Advance knowledge of routing protocols to include Border Gateway Protocol (BGP), Open Shortest Path First (OSPF), and Enhanced Interior Gateway Routing Protocol (EIGRP).
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network security concepts, including web filters, NIDPS, DLP, SSL\-DPI, firewalls, etc.
   

  

 Advanced knowledge of network services, including DNS, DHCP, IPAM, SNMP, IPSec, NetFlow.
   

  

 Knowledge of Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) and Network Access Control (NAC) technologies.
   

  

 Knowledge of scripting, automation, and DevOps functions including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC) and Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC).
   

  

 Experience working with Fortinet, Cisco, InfoBlox, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services (AWS) technologies.
   

  

 Experience with client facing Network Operations Center (NOC) support.
   

  

 Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
   

  

 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
   

  

 Experience with ITSM, ITIL, NIST, CIS, and ISO 27001 frameworks.
   

  

 Proven ability to lead and manage multiple priorities with proven organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with changing priorities.
   

  

 Experience with working with onshore and offshore global teams.
   

  

 Strong ability in multiple technologies, analytical techniques, and leadership skills.
   

  

 In\-depth knowledge of Operational Processes (Event, Incident, Change, Problem).
   

  

 Preferred Certifications:
   

  

 Microsoft Azure Certifications (AZ\-900, AZ\-700, AZ\-500, AZ\-204\)
   

  

 CompTIA \+ Certifications (Network\+, Security\+)
   

  

 Cisco Certifications (CCNA, CCNP)
   

  

**Educational Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

 3 to 7 years of experience as a Network Engineer in a global company.

description:
When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing…**
 As a Network Engineer, your primary focus is to evaluate how our network is managed and identify manual tasks that should be converted into automated workflows. You will study existing operational habits and system data to find inefficiencies.
   

  

* Analyze Operational Workflows: Review current network management processes and alarm data to identify repetitive manual interventions.
* Identify Automation Opportunities: Pinpoint specific areas where scripts or automated logic can replace manual troubleshooting or configuration steps.
* Evaluate Business Impact: Conduct deep\-dive investigations into various systems to determine which process improvements will provide the most significant time and cost savings.
* Align with Global Strategy: Coordinate with the US\-based engineering team to ensure your automation proposals solve current operational bottlenecks.


**What We’re Looking For…**
 You are a logical thinker who naturally looks for ways to make technical work more efficient. You enjoy deconstructing a complex manual process and figuring out the step\-by\-step logic required to automate it.
   

  

**You’ll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree with one or more years of professional work experience.
* Significant experience in Networking and knowledge of Network Automation.
* Functional knowledge of scripting and database management to develop integrated technical solutions.
* Analytical experience: The ability to look at complex technical datasets and identify patterns that suggest a need for a new automation.
* The ability to quickly learn and navigate internal systems to gather data for process reviews.
* Willingness to work a schedule that includes overlap with US Day shift.


**Even Better If You Have**
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* Experience interpreting existing automation scripts to improve or expand their functionality.
* Proficiency in Agile methodologies and Jira to track development lifecycles
* The ability to explain technical process changes to both end\-users and global stakeholders.


 Where you’ll be working
   

  

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

 40

title: Network Engineer
description:
We're looking for a Network Engineer to join our rapidly growing office in Mumbai. You'll be responsible for the design and management of both our enterprise and trading networks, optimising our systems for reliability, scalability and performance characteristics, like latency, to help us remain competitive in the market.
   

  

 Optiver’s bespoke infrastructure offers a diverse network engineering experience. Advance your career in a unique environment, where you'll be supported to find the simplest solutions to some of the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Optiver is a global market maker founded in Amsterdam, with offices in London, Chicago, Austin, New York, Sydney, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Mumbai. Established in 1986, today we are a leading liquidity provider, with close to 2,000 employees in offices around the world, united in our commitment to improve the market through competitive pricing, execution and risk management. By providing liquidity on multiple exchanges across the world in various financial instruments we participate in the safeguarding of healthy and efficient markets. We provide liquidity to financial markets using our own capital, at our own risk, trading a wide range of products: listed derivatives, cash equities, ETFs, bonds and foreign currencies.
   

  

 In Asia Pacific, Optiver was one of the first global market makers to establish a presence in the region, with the incorporation our Sydney office in 1996\. Since then, we have expanded our footprint by establishing offices in Taipei (2005\), Hong Kong (2007\), Shanghai (2012\) and Singapore (2021\). The business in Mumbai is newly established and deemed to be an integral part of the APAC strategy, with an anticipation of significant growth over the coming years.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 As a Network Engineer, you will:
   

  

  

* Be responsible for the infrastructure underpinning our trading and non\-trading activity, including office networks and a complex WAN environment. Our infrastructure needs to be reliable, fast and well supported and our Network Engineers are constantly making optimisations in reliability, capacity, scalability and latency.
* Build intimate knowledge of exchange environments, as well as Optiver’s trading systems, influencing low\- and high\-level designs.
* Deploy, monitor and configure network infrastructure, as well as support end\-to\-end infrastructure deployments in Asia Pacific data centers.
* Build, manage and support our complex international WAN environment.
* Collaborate with developers, researchers and hardware engineers on projects that require a stable and scalable platform to operate on.
* Automate, monitor and benchmark our various networks and systems.


**What You'll Get**
 You’ll join a culture of collaboration and excellence, where you’ll be surrounded by curious thinkers and creative problem solvers. Driven by a passion for continuous improvement, you’ll thrive in a supportive, high\-performing environment alongside talented colleagues, working collectively to tackle some of the most complex problems in the financial markets.
   

  

 In return for your expertise, you will have access to a range of Optiver perks, including:
   

  

  

* A performance\-based bonus structure unmatched anywhere in the industry. We combine our profits across desks, teams and offices into a global profit pool, fostering a truly collaborative environment.
* The chance to work alongside diverse and intelligent peers in a rewarding environment.
* Continuous learning, development and upskilling opportunities.
* Daily breakfast, lunch, and an in\-house barista.
* Gym/Club membership, plus weekly massages.
* Corporate health insurance
* Uber business for daily commute
* Regular social events, including a company trip every two years.


**Who You Are**
* Extensive experience designing, implementing and supporting complex networks using L2/L3 networks and technologies.
* Deep understanding of routing, switching and firewalls.
* Proficient with a scripting language e.g. Python, Bash or Shell.
* Comfortable overseeing and working with Unix systems, and have managed data centers.
* Experience in procuring, monitoring and managing diverse international LAN/WAN networks.
* Proven ability in delivering projects end\-to\-end individually and in a team environment (initiation through to implementation).
* Own certifications, like CCNP or CCIE.
* Experience working with trading networks, or designing and building ultra\-low latency networks using L1/FPGA based network devices.


**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**
 Optiver is committed to diversity and inclusion.
   

  

 We encourage applications from candidates from any and all backgrounds, and we welcome requests for reasonable adjustments during the process to ensure that you can best demonstrate your abilities. Please let us know if you would like to request any reasonable adjustments by contacting the Recruitment team via careers@optiver.com.au.

title: Network Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Ensono is a hybrid IT services provider that sees a world in transformation. We understand the world of business has become more complex, layered, and interdependent because we’re enabling the IT infrastructure for that transformation. Our clients are some of the most innovative and forward\-thinking companies in the world and we help keep their businesses thriving. With nearly 50 years of experience, we optimize and modernize IT infrastructure by amplifying the power of mainframes and mid\-range servers with the agility of cloud. Check us out at www.ensono.com.
   

  

**Job Role Summary**
 The Network Engineer is responsible for the implementation, and support of enterprise and data center–wide voice and data network solutions that align with Ensono’s architecture standards and business objectives. This role ensures stable, secure, and scalable network services for Ensono and its customers by developing, implementing, and maintaining network, security/threat, and voice solutions.
   

  

 The Network Engineer works independently on complex assignments, collaborates with senior engineers and cross‑functional teams, and provides technical guidance and mentorship to less experienced team members.
   

  

**Duties And Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery \& Operations**
* Implement, and maintain enterprise and data center network solutions, including routing, switching, security, voice, and load‑balancing technologies.
* Manage, configure, and troubleshoot routing and switching devices across enterprise networks.
* Implement and maintain firewall solutions using Palo Alto and/or Check Point technologies, including policy configuration, NAT, VPNs, and platform upgrades.
* Configure, monitor, and optimize load balancers (F5, Citrix NetScaler, A10, or equivalent) to ensure high availability and performance.
* Participate in network upgrades, migrations, and new deployments.


**Incident, Change \& Problem Management**
* Perform proactive network monitoring, incident response, and root cause analysis for escalated issues.
* Drive Major Incident (MI) calls end‑to‑end and ensure effective resolution and stakeholder communication.
* Participate in network‑related projects, change tickets, and trouble tickets.
* Assist in prioritization of network issues and provide frontline response to internal teams.


**Engineering Standards \& Documentation**
* Develop and maintain network documentation, including diagrams, configurations, standards, and guidelines.
* Contribute to network and security capacity planning activities.
* Ensure compliance with Ensono security standards and industry best practices.


**Collaboration \& Customer Engagement**
* Interact and consult with Ensono customers to gather solution requirements.
* Coordinate solutions with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Communicate project status effectively and support client satisfaction measurement.


**Leadership, Ownership \& Strategy**
* Fully functional and self‑directed on assigned work.
* Own high‑complexity and moderate‑complexity assignments; provide oversight and review for low‑complexity work.
* Lead high‑priority technical initiatives or processes.
* Act as a product, technology, or domain Subject Matter Expert (SME) as required.
* Provide formal or informal mentorship to less experienced associates.
* Contribute to product and technology strategy (e.g., Cisco or security platforms), including:
+ Input into product roadmaps and requirements
+ Collaboration with engineering and delivery teams to align strategy with implementation and operational capabilities


**Qualifications**
**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Strong knowledge of routing protocols (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP).
* Expertise in switching technologies (VLANs, STP, trunking, EtherChannel).
* Hands‑on experience with Cisco routing and switching technologies.
* Hands‑on experience with firewall technologies (Palo Alto and/or Check Point).
* Experience with load balancers such as F5, Citrix NetScaler, A10, or equivalent.
* Solid understanding of network security principles and best practices.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast‑paced, customer‑focused environment.


**Preferred**
* Advanced knowledge of routing, switching, and security policy design.
* Familiarity with network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Nagios).
* Relevant certifications or equivalent experience in one or more of the following:
+ CCNA, CCNP, CCDP, CCIE
+ Palo Alto (PCNSE)
+ F5 Certification
+ Check Point or other security certifications


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and operate effectively within a team environment.
* Demonstrates a holistic perspective and adjusts priorities based on the broader business impact.


**Shift Timing\-** 
 24\*7 Rotational Shift
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to caste, colour, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, HIV status, or any other status protected by law. Candidates with disabilities who require accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to contact our Talent Acquisition team to place a request.

title: Fortinet - Network Engineer
description:
**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced Senior Fortinet Network Engineer with 10\+ years of hands\-on expertise in designing, implementing, and managing enterprise\-grade network security infrastructures. The ideal candidate will have deep proficiency in Fortinet's Security Fabric ecosystem, including FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager, and related platforms. This is a fully remote position aligned to US business hours.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, deploy, and manage Fortinet FortiGate firewalls across enterprise and multi\-site environments.
* Configure and maintain advanced security policies, NAT rules, VPN tunnels (IPsec/SSL), and routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, Static).
* Administer FortiManager for centralized policy management and FortiAnalyzer for log management, reporting, and threat analysis.
* Implement and manage Fortinet Security Fabric integrations including FortiSwitch, FortiAP, FortiAuthenticator, and FortiSIEM.
* Design and maintain SD\-WAN solutions leveraging Fortinet's SD\-WAN capabilities for optimized traffic management.
* Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability assessments, and compliance reviews aligned to NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS benchmarks.
* Troubleshoot complex Layer 2/Layer 3 network issues and drive root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents.
* Collaborate with SOC, cloud, and infrastructure teams to integrate network security with broader enterprise architecture.
* Lead network capacity planning, performance monitoring, and lifecycle management for Fortinet infrastructure.
* Mentor junior engineers and support knowledge transfer within the team.
* Create and maintain detailed network documentation including topology diagrams, runbooks, and change records.
* Participate in on\-call rotation for critical US\-hours incidents as required.



  





**Experience Requirements** 



* Minimum 10 years of overall network engineering experience with at least 5 years focused on Fortinet technologies.
* Proven track record of managing enterprise Fortinet environments with 100\+ FortiGate devices or complex multi\-site deployments.
* Experience working in 24x7 NOC/SOC or managed services environments supporting US\-based clients.
* Prior experience in BFSI, Healthcare, Retail, or Technology verticals is an added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to handle P1/P2 incidents independently and drive resolution within SLA.
* Strong documentation skills – ability to produce HLD, LLD, and network topology diagrams.

 8\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Product Analyst in Financial Services.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**Aera Technology is the Decision Intelligence company.** 
 We deliver innovation and services that enable enterprises to operate sustainably, intelligently, and efficiently. Aera helps enterprises around the world transform decision making – delivering millions of recommendations that have resulted in significant revenue gains and cost savings for some of the world’s best\-known brands.

* Technical Accuracy: Work with SMEs to document the logic behind our Decision Skills, ensuring that data schemas and algorithmic outputs are accurately described.

* Lifecycle Management: Keep pace with rapid sprint cycles, ensuring documentation evolves as our AI models and data capabilities are updated.

* Educational Foundation: Degree in Computer Science, Technical Communication, or a related field, with a demonstrated understanding of Data Science and AI/ML fundamentals.
* Technical Literacy: Ability to read and explain technical architecture, including API structures (REST), JSON, and SQL basics.
* AI/ML Fluency: You must be comfortable discussing concepts like supervised/unsupervised learning, data modeling, and how AI\-driven insights are generated.
* Exceptional Writing: Superior command of English with the ability to explain “the why” behind the data, not just “the how” of the interface.
* Tool Proficiency: Experience with modern documentation stacks (e.g., Markdown, Confluence, Gitbook, or Docs\-as\-Code environments).
* Analytical Mindset: A proactive approach to learning how data flows through a platform to solve complex business problems.


 If you share our passion for building a sustainable, intelligent, and efficient world, you’re in the right place. Established in 2017 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, we're a series D start\-up, with teams in Mountain View, San Francisco (California), Bucharest and Cluj\-Napoca (Romania), Paris (France), Munich (Germany), London (UK), Pune (India), and Sydney (Australia). In addition to offering a competitive salary and company stock options, we have other great benefits available. You’ll find comprehensive medical, Group Medical Insurance, Term Insurance, Accidental Insurance, paid time off, Maternity leave, and much more. We offer unlimited access to online professional courses for both professional and personal development, coupled with people manager development programs. title: Technical Writer - GIS
description:
**About Us**
 Groundbreaker. Game changer. Pioneer.
   

  

 TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader.
   

  

 TRC's professionals work with a broad range of commercial, industrial and government clients and the communities they serve. We deliver breakthrough solutions that address local needs \-\- so our clients can better succeed in an ever\-changing world.
   

  

 Working at TRC means tackling interesting, meaningful projects. We pride ourselves on our collaborative spirit, entrepreneurial zeal and agile corporate structure. We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Technical Writer will be responsible for creating and maintaining high\-quality technical documentation for GIS solutions while leveraging their expertise in Esri technologies and solution design.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of GIS consulting, data engineering, and enterprise application integration. The Technical Writer will be responsible for producing high\-quality documentation across all project phases, from discovery and requirements gathering through data migration, integration design, training, and go\-live, ensuring that technical decisions, processes, and outcomes are clearly captured for diverse audiences including GIS analysts, IT administrators, field operations staff, and executive stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including user manuals, solution architecture diagrams, workflows, data mapping specifications, schema comparison reports, cutover runbooks and training materials for GIS applications.
* Document discovery workshop outputs covering commodity workflows (Electric, Gas, Water, Fiber), data models, IT landscape, interfaces, and project impacts.
* Work closely with GIS analysts, data engineers, developers, integration architects, stakeholders, and third\-party system vendors to understand technical workflows and translate them into clear, user\-friendly documentation.
* Document Utility Network configuration specifications including domain networks, tier management, subnetwork definitions, and topology rules.
* Produce integration readiness assessments capturing UN\-compatibility evaluations, gap analyses, and backward\-schema mapping requirements and ensure documentation adheres to industry standards and best practices, focusing on accuracy and usability.
* Create visual aids such as diagrams, data flow diagrams, and architecture diagrams and infographics to support written content.
* Create and maintain traceability matrices linking business requirements to technical design decisions across all project phases and organizational goals.
* Develop role\-based training content for multiple user groups and author quick reference guides, step\-by\-step SOPs, and annotated workflow diagrams for post\-migration operations.
* Support Organizational Change Management (OCM) by producing stakeholder communications, FAQs, and change impact summaries throughout the project lifecycle.
* Mentor junior team members in documentation practices and technical writing standards.
* Stay updated on emerging GIS technologies and trends to incorporate relevant information into documentation.
* Support presales and client\-facing activities by preparing technical presentations and proposals.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in GIS, Computer Science, English, Technical Writing, or a related field.
* 8 to 12 years of experience in technical writing, solution design, or GIS development.
* Expertise \& demonstrated experience documenting ArcGIS platform implementations, preferably ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, or ArcGIS Utility Network.
* Working knowledge of utility operations across at least one commodity domain: Electric, Gas, Water, or Fiber.
* Proven ability to document complex system integrations including API flows, data exchange mechanisms, and enterprise middleware.
* Strong understanding of geospatial concepts, including projections, coordinate systems, and data models.
* Proficiency in tools such as MS Word, Adobe Acrobat, Visio, and diagramming software.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple documentation projects simultaneously.
* Experience in mentoring or leading teams is a plus.


**Nice\-to\-Have (not Mandatory)**
* Prior exposure to ArcFM or Smallworld GIS environments and migration projects.
* Knowledge of ETL concepts, data modelling, and geodatabase schema documentation.
* Experience working in agile or hybrid project delivery environments.
* Familiarity with enterprise systems such as SCADA, OMS, ADMS, AMI, Maximo etc. or similar utility operational platforms.
* Understanding of Organizational Change Management (OCM) frameworks.


 EEO Statement

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Business Analyst — Healthcare \& Payments** 
**Techdome · Product Venture Studio · India (Hybrid) \| 3–5 Years \| Full\-time** 




  





**This Isn't a Spec\-Writing Job. It's a Product Operator Role.** 




 At Techdome, a BA isn't a ticket\-writer — you're a product operator. You'll sit between founders, engineers, clinicians, and payment partners, turning ambiguity into shipped features across two of the most regulated domains in software: healthcare and payments.
 



  





**What Techdome Is** 




 We're a 100\+ person product venture studio across Hyderabad, Indore, Mumbai, Dubai, and the US — bootstrapped, profitable, and building our own products. We ship MVPs in weeks, not quarters. Our portfolio includes Wizlo (telehealth for GLP\-1 clinics), JustInterview.ai (AI\-powered hiring), and Sparrow (enterprise onboarding). Every product we touch handles PHI or moves money — usually both.
 



  





**Why Healthcare \+ Payments — Why Both Matter** 




 A BA with experience in only one will struggle here. Our products live at the intersection — patient intake, e\-prescriptions, subscription billing, KYC, claims, and settlement flows all within a single HIPAA \+ PCI scope. You'll run discovery calls with US clinic operators or payments partners and walk out with a buildable spec by end of week.
 



  





**You'll Work Directly With Founders** 




**Rahul Joshi (CEO)** 
 — \#1 n8n expert globally. Owns GTM, staffing, JustInterview.ai, and stock automation. You'll work with him on customer discovery and turning partnerships into structured requirements.
 



**Gaurav Chouhan (CTO)** 
 — Leads engineering, architecture, and compliance posture across the portfolio. You'll work with him to translate requirements into architectural decisions and validate what's shippable.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




**Discovery \& Requirements** 



* Run stakeholder interviews; translate messy conversations into user stories, flows, and acceptance criteria
* Map current vs. future\-state processes across clinical, billing, and payment workflows
* Document decisions and tradeoffs engineering can build from and clients can sign off on



**Healthcare** 



* Design HIPAA\-aware workflows with clinicians and ops teams
* Map clinical data models: patient records, prescriptions, encounters, eligibility
* Drive requirements for telehealth, e\-prescribing, and patient communication



**Payments** 



* Define requirements for subscriptions, refunds, dunning, chargebacks, and reconciliation
* Work with Stripe, Braintree, ACH/UPI providers on integration scope
* Ensure PCI and regional compliance is baked into specs, not bolted on later



**Product Operating** 



* Partner with engineering and design through build, QA, and release
* Run sprint reviews, UAT, and customer feedback loops
* Maintain backlogs, roadmaps, and release notes



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must Have:** 



* 3–5 years as a BA, Product Analyst, or Product Owner in a real product environment
* Healthcare experience: telehealth, EHR/EMR, claims, eligibility, HIPAA — non\-negotiable
* Payments experience: subscription billing, gateway integrations, reconciliation, PCI scope — non\-negotiable
* Strong analytical instincts — you can turn a 60\-min call into a structured artifact
* Excellent written communication; your specs are read, not skimmed
* Daily comfort with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Notion AI, etc.)
* Strong accountability — your deliverables land on time



**Strong Plus:** 



* US healthcare (ICD/CPT, payer/claims, telehealth); India or UAE payments rails
* Process modeling tools (BPMN, Lucidchart, Miro) and product tools (Jira, Linear, Notion)
* SQL / data literacy — you pull numbers instead of asking for them
* Experience writing for both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders



  





**What Makes Techdome Different** 



* **3x faster growth** 
 — you'll touch healthcare, payments, and AI products within six months
* **Direct founder access** 
 — Rahul and Gaurav are active in product decisions; no manager layers
* **AI\-first by design** 
 — AI tooling is the foundation of how we work, not a perk
* **Products from zero to exit** 
 — JustInterview.ai is on an M\&A track; Sparrow is going enterprise; Wizlo is live with paying clinics
* **Ideas over egos** 
 — the best idea wins, regardless of who said it



  





**The Culture in Plain English** 




 Own outcomes, not artifacts. Default to clarity. Use AI aggressively. Challenge the brief. Be in the room.
 



  





**Compensation \& Perks** 



* Competitive salary — market rate or better
* Performance\-based growth tied to product milestones
* Direct exposure to M\&A, fundraising, and venture studio decisions
* Your resume looks completely different in 24 months



  





**How to Apply — Two Steps** 




 Step 1 — AI Interview (10–15 minutes) Complete the first\-round interview on JustInterview.ai (our own AI interview platform):
 



 https://app.justinterview.ai/apply/10002555
 



  





 Step 2 \- If selected team will reach out to you within 24 hours after completion.

title: Selenium API - Software Development Engineer in Test
description:
**Role Overview**
 We are seeking seasoned Senior SDET experienced in automation testing, API validation, and quality engineering, specifically within e commerce and checkout ecosystems. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, accuracy, and scalability of customer facing commerce and checkout workflows, including cart, payment, order placement, and post order integrations. As part of the Quality Engineering organization, you will work closely with Product, Engineering, DevOps, and Architecture teams to deliver secure, resilient, and high performing checkout experiences at scale.
   

  

 This is a Hybrid position located at our Bangalore, India, development center. You will be required to be on\-site 2 to 3 days per week. When you are not working on\-site, you will be working from your home office. We are only considering candidates within a commutable distance to our Bangalore office and are not offering relocation assistance at this time.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI and API testing, with a strong focus on checkout, payments, and order lifecycle workflows.
* Create and execute comprehensive test strategies covering functional, regression, integration, and end‑to‑end checkout scenarios, including edge cases and failure handling.
* Validate complex API integrations across checkout services and its integrations.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps teams to clarify checkout requirements, identify defects early, perform root cause analysis, and ensure high‑quality, zero‑regression releases.
* Strengthen CI/CD pipelines by integrating automation suites, improving test coverage, and enforcing quality gates aligned with Agile/Scrum practices.
* Take end‑to‑end ownership of checkout quality, proactively identifying risks related to performance, reliability, and scalability during peak traffic and high‑volume transactions.


**About You**
* 8–12 years of experience as a Senior SDET or QA Automation Engineer, with strong ownership of testing strategy for e‑commerce and checkout platforms.
* Strong hands‑on experience with Java, Selenium, and API automation with additional exposure to .NET, Node.js, SQL, and PostgreSQL.
* Experience with API automation tools such as Rest Assured, postman or Karate is highly desirable.
* Proven e‑commerce domain expertise, particularly in cart, checkout, payments, fraud validation, order processing, and post‑order flows.
* Comfortable working with distributed teams, proactive in communication, and highly detail‑oriented.
* A quality‑driven engineer who can build robust automation frameworks, reduce production defects, and improve overall checkout reliability.


**Company Overview**
 McAfee is a leader in personal security for consumers. Focused on protecting people, not just devices, McAfee consumer solutions adapt to users’ needs in an always online world, empowering them to live securely through integrated, intuitive solutions that protects their families and communities with the right security at the right moment.
   

  

**Company Benefits And Perks**
 We work hard to embrace diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone at McAfee to bring their authentic selves to work every day. We’re proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified in 10 countries, a reflection of the supportive, empowering environment we’ve built where people feel seen, valued, and energized to reach their full potential and thrive.
   

  

 We offer a variety of social programs, flexible work hours and family\-friendly benefits to all of our employees.
   

  

* Bonus Program
* Pension and Retirement Plans
* Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Parental Leave
* Support for Community Involvement


 We're serious about our commitment to diversity which is why McAfee prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other legally protected status.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
   

  

 At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
   

  

 Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Summary
   

  

 Software Engineers conduct, plan, or oversee one or more aspects of the analysis, design, programming, debugging, and modification of computer programs for commercial or end user applications. They write code, complete programming, and perform testing and debugging of applications. Responsibilities also include completing documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance. Software Engineers may interface with users to define system requirements and/or necessary modifications or develop cost estimates, budgets, and schedules.
   

  

 All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Write, modify, and review high\-quality, testable, and efficient code across front\-end, back\-end, and data layers.
* Integrate systems via APIs, messaging queues, and databases.
* Develop and maintain data pipelines and large\-scale data processing jobs using appropriate frameworks and cloud services.
* Develop unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests with a strong focus on automation.
* Maintain CI pipelines to run tests automatically upon code commits.
* Debug and perform root cause analysis on issues, using AI\-driven tools where applicable, and enforce code quality gates through reviews and static analysis.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines; package and deploy applications to various environments using containerization and orchestration tools.
* Monitor applications in production using observability tools; investigate incidents, analyze logs, identify root causes, and implement fixes.
* Optimize code for performance, cost efficiency, and maintainability.
* Apply secure coding practices, manage secrets properly, validate inputs, and ensure authentication/authorization is robust.
* Comply with regulatory standards and maintain documentation for audits.


 This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Basic Qualifications:
   

  

 Bachelor's degree, OR 1\+ years of relevant work experience.
   

  

 Experience in developing and/or implementing web\-based or mobile applications.
   

  

 Experience in writing, modifying, and reviewing code for commercial or end user applications.
   

  

 Experience in debugging and performing root cause analysis on software issues.
   

  

 Experience in developing unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests.
   

  

 Experience in integrating systems via APIs, messaging queues, and databases.
   

  

 Experience in maintaining CI/CD pipelines and deploying applications.
   

  

 Experience in applying secure coding practices and complying with regulatory standards.
   

  

 Good technical experience with JAVA, Spring, Hibernate.
   

  

 Experience in code development using Eclipse/MyEclipse, JetBrains IntelliJ or
   

  

 any major Java IDE
   

  

 Experience with GIT/Stash, Maven and Jenkins

**Who we are** 

  





 Ekam Apps is a lean, AI\-first studio building products and automation for clients across India and Australia. We ship fast with a small team because our entire workflow runs on Claude and AI\-native dev tools.
 



  





 We also build our own products under Turrant.ai:
 



  





 Turrant \- AI\-powered process automation for document collection, verification, and approvals across WhatsApp, email, and branded portals. 50\+ document types, 800\+ government source verifications, 250\+ integrations, no\-code.
 



 ComWise \- unified WhatsApp \+ web chat inbox with an AI copilot, workflow automation, broadcast campaigns, and one\-click human takeover. Powered by Claude, Gemini, and GPT with vector\-search grounding.
 



  





 You'll work directly with the founder, Nitin Gupta \-19\+ years in tech, 12\+ in leadership across India Today Group, Lenskart, SeniorWorld, and Zecross. Small team, no layers.
   




**The role** 

  





**We're looking for a fresher who thinks in AI \- not someone who occasionally uses it, but someone who reaches for it instinctively and knows how to extract 10x output from these tools.** 




**You'll be a full stack engineer across multiple live projects. One hour you might be building a Next.js dashboard for an Australian client, the next wiring up a Supabase edge function, and after lunch debugging a WhatsApp bot on Turrant.** 




**Fair warning: this is a startup. Some weeks are exhilarating \- shipping features, watching users react. Some weeks are grinding \- debugging edge cases, reworking something for the third time. We need someone who rides both with composure.**



**What you'll do** 

  




* Ship full stack features end\-to\-end \- Next.js, React, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Supabase
* Work with Claude, GPT, and Gemini APIs daily \- prompt engineering to agentic workflows
* Use Claude Code, Cursor, and Copilot as your primary dev environment, and get maximum value from them
* Integrate third\-party APIs \- payment gateways, Zoho, HubSpot, WhatsApp Business, government verification
* Own what you build \- first commit, production deploy, and the 9pm bug fix
* Context\-switch across 2–3 projects in a day without losing quality


**Who you are** 

  




* Humble, low ego. No task is beneath you. You'd rather help a teammate than prove you're the smartest in the room.
* Hands\-on but smart about AI. Claude is your pair programmer, not a crutch. You know when to prompt and when to think.
* Agile across contexts. React component, Python script, client thread \- same morning, all done well.
* Startup\-mature. You handle ambiguity, take ownership, and don't crumble when plans change. They will.


**Requirements** 

  




* B.Tech in CS, IT, or ECE from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 institute (2024–2026 batch)
* Solid fundamentals in JavaScript/TypeScript or Python
* Working knowledge of (or strong willingness to learn) Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL

* Real understanding of LLMs \- prompting, context windows, token limits, model selection
* Excellent written communication \- you'll be in client threads all day


**Bonus** 

  




* Side project or hackathon entry built on AI APIs
* Open source contributions
* Experience with Supabase/Firebase, OCR, or document verification systems


**What you'll gain** 

  




* Direct mentorship from the founder, no hierarchy buffer
* Production AI systems used by real customers in India and Australia
* Breadth of a B2B SaaS product
 *and* 
 client work \- rare for a fresher
* An AI workflow that puts you ahead of engineers with 5 years' experience
* Real ownership from week one. Not coffee runs, not throwaway unit tests.


**Details** 

  




* Salary: ₹20,000/month during 3\-month probation, then ₹35,000/month (₹4\.2 LPA) \+ performance bonus up to ₹1\.5 lakhs
* Location: Fully remote
* Hours: Full\-time, 9 hours/day, alternate Saturdays
* Benefits: Performance\-based ESOPs, AI tool subscriptions covered

Are you inspired by challenging the status quo? Do you thrive in collaborative environments that drive results? If so, Gates could be for you.  

  

Gates is a leading manufacturer of application\-specific fluid power and power transmission solutions. We push the boundaries of material science to engineer solutions that continually exceed customer expectations.  

  

Let's simplify it, think belts and hoses. Found in motorcycles, conveyor belts, cars, tractors, blenders, vacuum cleaners, bicycles, \& 3D printers just to name a few. Because why not do it all?

* Participate in the problem analysis determination and corrective action implementation of internal and external customer complaints.

* Maintain a safe work environment by enforcing safety regulations and guidelines. Encourage team members to prioritize safety and report any hazards, fostering an environment where safety is everyone’s responsibility.
* Provide leadership to supervisors, support staff, and production personnel.
* Lead hiring, training, onboarding, and retention initiatives for shop floor employees.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across processes and workflows.
* Partner with supply chain, quality, engineering, HR, and maintenance teams to ensure seamless operations.


The incumbent will also need to ensure:



* Adherence to Gates code of conduct \& ethics. Shall set an example as a role model for his team in areas of personal character, commitment, organizational and work habits.


* To ensure compliance of HSE standards as stated in the policy in his area of work. As a responsible employee of the organization, he has to bring to the attention of the safety committee any unsafe practice/working conditions in the facility. Acts as part of the team coordinating engineering changes, product line extension, or new product launches to ensure timely and orderly material and production flow transitions.


**Supervisory Responsibilities**
--------------------------------



The incumbent reports to Plant Head \-Faridabad and Pune and supports him in all day\-to\-day operations to achieve the business objectives of the company. Production, Quality ,Maintenance, HSE and Continuous Improvement teams report into this role.

**Requirements and Preferred Skills**
-------------------------------------


**QUALIFICATIONS:** *To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.*


* BE/ MBA (master’s will be preferable) in Engineering/Operations.
* Must have a minimum of 8\-10 years’ experience in Production.


**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* Proven leadership and management skills with the ability to optimize team performance and development.


* Excellent communication, interpersonal and influencing skills.


* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving abilities.


* Commercially and financially astute with experience of managing budgets.


* Resilient, self\-motivated and able to work well under pressure.


* Technical knowledge products, process \& product costing.


* Excellent operations skills are required.


* Ability to make decisions on the go in liaison with the relevant stakeholders.


* This role requires a self\-driven self\-starter.


* Recognize obstacles and implement solutions to drive positive results.


* Must have a high degree of confidentiality and ethics.


* Understands market dynamics as well as the legal and regulatory landscape.


* Must have knowledge of the Oracle/SAP ERP system.



WHY GATES?


Founded in 1911 in Denver, Colorado, Gates is publicly traded on the NYSE. While we might operate in a vast amount of time zones we operate as 'One Gates' and have a common goal of pushing the boundaries of materials science. We invest in our people, bringing real\-world experience that enables us to solve our customers' diverse challenges of today and anticipate those of tomorrow.


WORK ENVIRONMENT


Gates is an Equal Opportunity and is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job\-related reasons regardless of race, sex, color, religion, age, disability, pregnancy, citizenship, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other consideration defined by law.

 We’re seeking a results\-driven Global Training \& Development Specialist to lead the design and delivery of high impact learning programs across our global organization.
